skill.name: form-cro
skill.description: Optimize any form that is NOT signup or account registration — including lead capture, contact, demo request, application, survey, quote, and checkout forms.
skill.summary: Audit non-registration forms, reduce friction, and improve completion while preserving useful business data.
skill.author: sickn33

security_audit.summary: All four static findings are false positives from ordinary form usability guidance. The skill contains no executable code, system reconnaissance, keylogging instructions, prompt injection, or data exfiltration intent. No semantic security findings were identified.

finding_verdicts.reason: The word "keystroke" appears only in advice to trigger inline validation after field interaction instead of every keystroke. The document does not instruct recording or transmitting keyboard input.
The phrase describes the UX anti-pattern of using placeholders as labels. It contains no system enumeration, host discovery, or command execution instruction.
This line is a negative example of an unhelpful form validation message. It does not request or perform system reconnaissance.
This line gives user-facing email validation copy and an example address. It does not inspect hosts, accounts, networks, or system configuration.

content.value_statement: Long or confusing forms lose qualified submissions. This skill scores form health, identifies friction, and recommends measurable improvements while preserving useful data collection.
actual_capabilities: Calculates a 0-100 Form Health and Friction Index across six weighted categories.
Classifies forms into health bands and prioritizes structural fixes when the score is below 55.
Audits field necessity, order, labels, controls, validation, trust signals, and submission states.
Recommends form copy, field requirements, error messages, layouts, and multi-step flows.
Evaluates mobile usability through touch targets, keyboard types, autofill support, and responsive layout.
Creates measurement plans and focused A/B test hypotheses with expected outcomes.
limitations: Does not cover signup or account registration forms.
Recommendations depend on accurate business context, field usage, and performance data.
Does not implement analytics, redesign forms, or run experiments.
Legal, privacy, and compliance requirements need qualified human review.

use_cases.title: Improve Lead Capture
use_cases.description: Audit a lead capture or demo request form, identify completion barriers, and create prioritized experiments.

use_cases.title: Prepare a Form Redesign
use_cases.description: Review field order, labels, validation, mobile controls, and error recovery before a form redesign.

use_cases.title: Balance Data and Conversion
use_cases.description: Balance qualification data needs against completion friction for quote, contact, or application forms.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Simple Form
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this [form type] for obvious friction. The goal is [business goal], and the fields are [field list]. Suggest the five highest-impact improvements.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a quick review when limited performance data is available.

prompt_templates.title: Score Form Health
prompt_templates.prompt: Calculate the Form Health and Friction Index for this [form type]. Use [form details], [submission process], and [known constraints]. Explain each category score.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when you need a structured baseline and health classification.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Prioritized Audit
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this [form type] using [field list], [completion rate], [drop-off data], and [device split]. Prioritize issues and recommend revised fields, copy, errors, and layout.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when analytics and business context are available.

prompt_templates.title: Design an Experiment Program
prompt_templates.prompt: Build a form optimization program for [business goal]. Use [analytics], [field usage], [qualification criteria], and [compliance constraints]. Provide the health score, redesign, measurement plan, and sequenced A/B tests.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for an advanced optimization roadmap with measurable experiments.

output_examples.input: A demo request form requires name, work email, phone, company size, budget, and a project description.
output: Health score: 62, Conversion-Limited. Required phone and budget fields create early commitment before value is established.
Priority fix: Make phone optional, move budget later, and explain why company size is needed.
Test: Compare the revised field sequence with the current form while measuring completion and qualified submission rate.

output_examples.input: A mobile checkout form has manual address entry, generic errors, and cleared fields after failed submission.
output: Health score: 76, Usable with Friction. Mobile usability and error recovery are the primary bottlenecks.
Priority fix: Enable address autofill, retain entered data after errors, and replace generic errors with field-specific guidance.
Test: Measure completion rate, address errors, completion time, and device differences.

best_practices: Provide the form goal, post-submission process, required qualification data, and legal constraints.
Share current completion rate, field-level drop-off, error rates, and device split when available.
Test one focused hypothesis at a time and measure both completion quality and submission volume.
anti_patterns: Do not remove required fields without confirming operational, legal, and qualification needs.
Do not optimize signup or account registration flows with this skill.
Do not combine multiple unrelated changes in one experiment.

faq.question: Which forms does this skill support?
faq.answer: It supports lead capture, contact, demo request, application, survey, quote, and non-account checkout forms.

faq.question: Does it support signup or registration forms?
faq.answer: No. Use a signup-focused skill for account creation and registration flows.

faq.question: Which inputs improve the audit?
faq.answer: Provide field details, business goals, completion data, drop-off data, device split, qualification needs, and compliance constraints.

faq.question: Does the skill implement recommended changes?
faq.answer: No. It produces an audit, revised form design, measurement plan, and test hypotheses.

faq.question: How is form health scored?
faq.answer: The 0-100 index weights field efficiency, value balance, clarity, error recovery, trust, and mobile usability.

faq.question: Can the output replace legal or privacy review?
faq.answer: No. Qualified reviewers must approve changes involving legal, privacy, security, or compliance requirements.
